input.description: Single-measure CI so the profile page tile is titled "Orders (Last 30 Days)"; keyed on the unified individual Id
input.expression: SELECT UnifiedssotIndividualWstr__dlm.ssot__Id__c AS unified_individual_id__c, SUM(CASE WHEN DATEDIFF(CURRENT_DATE(), ssot__SalesOrder__dlm.ssot__OrderStartDate__c) <= 30 THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS orders_last_30_days__c FROM ssot__SalesOrder__dlm INNER JOIN UnifiedLinkssotIndividualWstr__dlm ON ssot__SalesOrder__dlm.ssot__SoldToCustomerId__c = UnifiedLinkssotIndividualWstr__dlm.SourceRecordId__c INNER JOIN UnifiedssotIndividualWstr__dlm ON UnifiedLinkssotIndividualWstr__dlm.UnifiedRecordId__c = UnifiedssotIndividualWstr__dlm.ssot__Id__c GROUP BY UnifiedssotIndividualWstr__dlm.ssot__Id__c
